title: A Room for the Well
author: Ivo Coldharbour
blurb: Zephyrine Crane, a hospice nurse who hears the dying count backwards, has spent twenty years telling themselves the noises have explanations. But when the village's church bell rings although the bell was melted down in 1911, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. Now they must hold out until sunrise with the truth about what was invited in, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
